assets.title: Assets and monitoring
assets.intro: Connect a generation object, get a key and start sending readings. The first readings appear here as soon as they are accepted.
assets.keysHelp: A key is shown once. Readings arrive two ways. REST: POST /api/v1/telemetry/readings with an Authorization header holding «Bearer» and the key. MQTT: publish to the topic poolwatt/v1/assets/{assetId}/readings, with a JSON body carrying key, intervalStart and energyKwh. A key issued with a signing secret must sign every message: over MQTT add the fields ts with the Unix time in seconds and sig with «v1=» and the HMAC-SHA256 of the line v1.<ts>.MQTT.<topic>.<interval>:<kWh to three decimals>, several readings joined by a semicolon.
assets.keyOnce: Save the key now — it will not be shown again.
assets.secretOnce: Signing secret — save it together with the key. Sign every request: X-Poolwatt-Timestamp with the Unix time in seconds, X-Poolwatt-Signature with «v1=» and the HMAC-SHA256 of the line v1.<timestamp>.POST.<path>.<SHA-256 of the body>, taken with this secret.
assets.unsigned: no signature — reissue the key to start signing
assets.noReadings: No readings yet. The first interval your equipment sends will show up here.
assets.rulesHelp: The shares must add up to 100. What is not sold goes to storage or to you by these shares.

zones.title: Zones and prices

reconciliation.title: Token registry reconciliation
reconciliation.intro: Every night the registry is checked against the meter readings it was issued from (ТЗ §16.11). Nothing is ever repaired automatically: a disagreement is a bug upstream, and a check that fixes its own findings hides them.
reconciliation.noRuns: No runs yet. The worker runs one every night at 03:15.
reconciliation.externalFeed: «Данные сети» here means the readings signed by the assets themselves. Comparing against the grid operator's own statement needs a contract and a feed from them — the per-asset daily total is shaped so that feed can be dropped in beside it.

analytics.intro: What the campaigns did: who got a gift, who came for the first time, who came back, how many kWh it cost and what those clients brought in. Below — shows and clicks on your content.
analytics.contentNote: Shows and clicks are counted per piece of content of the network: the system holds no link between a campaign and a piece of content, and we did not invent one.

gifts.intro: Gift kWh are a partner's bonus, not your balance: they can only be spent at that partner's stations, and they are always spent first.

pricing.title: Tariffs
pricing.intro: Everything you charge, in one place. Each number carries the version it is at: a change applies to new sessions, while bookings and receipts already made keep the numbers they were made under.
pricing.historyHelp: Every tariff change is kept. Nothing here can be edited — that is the point.
pricing.noTariff: No tariff set for this point.
pricing.subpartnersHelp: A percentage of what is earned at a franchisee's points, taken after the platform's own commission. Both sides see the same number in their books.

feePlans.title: Fee plans
feePlans.intro: Commission on trades, charging and bookings, by partner type and plan. A partner on no plan pays the default; a partner with individual terms pays those.
feePlans.cardsClosed: Card tariffs — issuing, servicing, interchange — are set by the card scheme and the EMI. There is no contract yet, so they are not here: an invented interchange rate would be a wrong number on a real invoice.
feePlans.noPlans: No plans yet. Until one is created, the platform charges the built-in 1 % on trades and 2 % on charging.
feePlans.noAssignments: Nobody has been put on a plan yet.
feePlans.assignHelp: Leave an override empty to keep the plan's own rate. A partner is either a listed company or a charging network, not both.

bookingsReport.title: Bookings and no-shows
bookingsReport.intro: A booking counts on the day it was for, not the day it was made. The money is what each booking itself says: changing your terms does not rewrite a month that is closed.

coop.listIntro: Shares, income and the votes on where the next battery goes.
coop.noMemberships: You are not a member of a cooperative. Membership is granted by the cooperative itself.
coop.sharesHelp: Income is split by shares; a vote is one member, one vote, whatever the shares.
coop.votesHelp: One member, one vote. The score appears only once the vote closes — until then nobody, including you, can read the outcome early. Votes are opened and closed by the Poolwatt operator: the cooperative's board is not in the system yet.
coop.noScoreYet: The score appears after the vote closes.

templates.title: One offer, every point
templates.intro: A template carries tariffs and opening hours — the two things §29.5 lets you change without going back through moderation. Applying one never touches a point's status, so no station is un-published by pressing a button.
templates.formHelp: Hours here are hours of the day: 0 to 24. Leave a price empty to say the point does not take that kind of payment.
templates.allHint: Applying replaces each point's tariffs with the template's, and records a version for each of them.

pipeline.title: New points funnel
pipeline.intro: The seven stages a place goes through before it is a station. Each card carries the person answerable and the date it is due; a lost lead keeps its card and its reason, because a funnel without its losses measures nothing.
pipeline.lostHelp: Kept on purpose: the ratio between the columns is the only thing a funnel measures.
pipeline.uploadHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 20 MB. A lease or a grid agreement is not a public file: only your network can open it.

warehouse.title: Store
warehouse.intro: A level here is the sum of its movements — nothing is typed over it. Set a minimum and a request is raised the moment the level crosses it, and whoever keeps that store is told.
warehouse.operationsHint: Receipt, transfer, write-off, return of a faulty part and a stocktake. A write-off asks for a reason; a stocktake is recorded as the difference it found.
warehouse.partsHint: Compatible models, comma separated. A unit cost rides along with every issue, so the cost of servicing a point is real.

roaming.title: Charging in another country
roaming.intro: kWh bought in one zone can be spent in another. The rate is the ratio of the two zones' spot references plus the clearing partner's fee. Both the rate and the debit are shown before you confirm.

install.subtitle: The same Poolwatt, on your home screen: the charging map, your balance, your station.
install.pwaBody: Works on Android and on iPhone. Nothing to download from a store — the browser puts the icon on your screen itself.
install.iosTestflight: The native iOS build is distributed through TestFlight. An invitation goes to your Apple ID, and only the owner can add a tester — there is no public link.
install.androidBody: A build signed outside Google Play, so Android will ask for permission to install it.
install.qrBody: Point the phone camera at the code.
